g.text: Read-back paths — disk drives a session
WRITE side (JSONL / video / HAR / downloads) for one pool
— the dashboard/discovery/cleanup readers still use the
reject stops before browser/artifact side effects.
credentials keeps short/common identity values from
corrupting unrelated selectors, URLs and prose.
all preserves the legacy maximum-privacy behavior.
A screenshot whose page renders a classified value
is refused, naming surface/tier/arg — never the value.
on macro_run failure (≥0.4 KB preview inline)
